ops.title: worker_log_key crash was already fixed in 12.23.2; log tracebacks were historical
ops.body:
Task 6a698b6 was filed 2026-09-02 off tracebacks in ~/Library/Caches/captain-hook/host-v1/capt-hookd.log without checking which build emitted them. captain_hook/worker/__main__.py:48-52 has carried the guard since 12.23.2: os.getcwd() wrapped in try/except FileNotFoundError falling back to a pid-derived key ('deleted-root-<pid>'), which keeps such workers on separate log files instead of killing dispatch.

Version histogram of the log's tracebacks: 12.22.1 (6067), 12.21.4 (4928), 12.22.0 (2526), 12.21.3 (2115), 12.22.3 (244) — all pre-fix. No worker_log_key traceback from 12.23.2 or later.

Lesson worth keeping: that daemon log is append-only across upgrades and is ~12MB of mostly historical stack traces, so a traceback in it proves nothing about the installed build. Always histogram the emitting version before filing.
